out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. CFM NOT PRESENT UPON THE START OF THE INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CDI: CFM ARRIVED AT THE BEGINNING OF THE INSPECTION. ENSURE AT LEAST ONE CFM IS PRESENT DURING OPERATIONS. RECOMMEND CERTIFYING MORE FOOD EMPLOYEES.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW HARDSHELL EGGS STORED NEXT TO BEAN SPROUTS IN THE TWO DOOR BEVERAGE COOLER (3), COOKED CURRY NEXT TO RAW CHICKEN IN THREE- DOOR PREP/COOLER (2), RAW CHICKEN AND RAW BEEF STORED NEXT TO LETTUCE AND OVER CONTAINERS OF CURRY IN THE TWO-DOOR UPRIGHT COOLER (4).
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: PIC RE-ARRANGED THE FOODS.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Eggs Stored at 45F or less
violations.observation: Observed an ambient air temperature above 45F in the following refrigeration unit holding raw shells eggs: Raw hardshell eggs at room temperature on a table next to the cook line. The eggs were taken out of a refrigerator 2.5 hours prior.
violations.corrective_action: Shell eggs that have not been treated to destroy Salmonella shall be stored in refrigerated equipment that maintains an ambient temperature of 45F or less. CDI: RAW HARD SHELL EGGS WERE RELOCATED TO THE PREP UNIT COOLER ON THE COOK LINE TO COOL DOWN TO 41.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: half and half milk (45 F) in the two-door flat top cooler (5). The half and half was not taken out since the day prior. Ambient temperature of the unit read 46 F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: 1) PIC DISCARDED THE HALF AND HALF MILK.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. OBSERVED LYSOL WIPES STORED NEXT TO EQUIPMENT IN THE KITCHEN AND NEXT TO FOOD ITEMS IN THE BAR AREA.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. CDI: LYSOL WIPES WERE RE-LOCATED. FINN THAI RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 10/06/2026) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: Storage-Personal Care Items

violations.corrective_action: All employees' personal care items shall be stored in a way that prevents the contamination of food and food contact surfaces through improper labeling or storage. CDI: PIC REMOVED THE MEDICATIONS.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: bulk dry goods, sauce bottles, and spice containers on the cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. OBSERVED THE FOLLOWING ON THE FLOOR: FRYING OIL, PACKAGED UNCOOKED NOODLES, AND CANNED COCONUT MILK IN THE DRY STORAGE AREA AND BOTTLES DRINKS IN THE BAR AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. ENSURE ALL FOODS ARE KEPT OFF THE FLOOR BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: TWO-DOOR FLAT TOP COOLER IN THE BAR AREA WITH AN AMBIENT TEMPERATURE OF 46 F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC WILL CALL TECHNICIAN IF LOWERING THE TEMPERATURE OF THE UNIT DOES NOT WORK. ENSURE UNIT IS FIXED BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION. PIC WILL NOT STORE TCS FOODS IN THE UNIT UNTIL FIXED.

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Weight and Thickness
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not sufficient in weight and thickness: OBSERVED NON-FOOD GRADE STORAGE CONTAINERS USED TO STORE FOOD.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be sufficient in weight and thickness to withstand repeated warewashing. DISCONTINUE USE OF THE CONTAINERS BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION. FINN THAI RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 10/06/2026) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: 1) knives were being stored in between a rod and a cooler.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. STAFF MOVED THE KNIVES TO BE WASHED AND SANITIZED. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO KEEP KNIVES ON THE MAGNETIC STRIP.

violations.observation: Observed a staff member rinse off her gloved hands at the hand sink. When instructed to remove the gloves, she only rinsed her hands with water and did not use soap.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. EHS INSTRUCTED THE STAFF MEMBER TO REWASH HER HANDS PROPERLY USING SOAP AND NO GLOVES.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: Observed a staff member wash her hands at the bar 3-vat sink.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EHS INSTRUCTED THE STAFF MEMBER TO ONLY USE DESIGNATED HAND SINKS FOR HAND WASHING.

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: 1) Observed frozen foods like seafood being thawed at room temperature.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF MEMBER TO MOVE THE FROZEN FOODS TO REFRIGERATOR FOR PROPER THAWING.
